githubRun.reason: The branch workflow is pull-request triggered; G3-P3-B01 creates or updates the sole Goal 03 to Goal 2 PR and records its run URL and ID.

notes: The workflow retains runtime-ci and runtime-compose and adds the independent pms-api-production job.
The new job pins Node 22, pnpm 11.13.1, and PostgreSQL 17, and runs five non-empty commands including the frozen install.
The PMS job uploads no artifacts and defines no custom log step for its ephemeral database URL.
Workflow concurrency cancels only superseded pull-request commits; push runs are retained.
Worker production composition, PM2 Production Bridge, release readiness, and rollout remain explicitly deferred.
